high_level_description: The image is a split-screen photo featuring President Joe Biden at two different moments during his visit to Manaus, Brazil. Left Side: Setting: The left side shows President Biden stepping off an aircraft. The background includes the tail section of the plane with the U.S. presidential seal prominently displayed on the fuselage. People: President Biden is wearing a blue jumpsuit and sunglasses, standing on the steps of the aircraft. He appears to be gesturing with his hands as he disembarks.
